preconditions.description: Both input strings s and t are non-empty.
The length of each string does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' if (t in s_as_subsequence and all(i in covered_indices(s, t) for i in range(len(s)))) else 'No'
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if t is a subsequence of s and every index of s is used in at least one valid subsequence occurrence of t; otherwise output 'No'.
